content.json:
# ChatOps Teams - Operational Dashboard

Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for the ChatOps application including performance, business metrics, and security indicators.

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.query:
customEvents
| extend env = tostring(customDimensions.environment)
| where isnotempty(env)
| distinct env
| order by env asc

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(duration)
| extend AvgDurationMs = round(AvgDuration, 2)
| project AvgDurationMs
content.title: Average Response Time (ms)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Total = count(), Failed = countif(success == false)
| extend ErrorRate = round((Failed * 100.0) / Total, 2)
| project ErrorRate
content.title: Error Rate (%)

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize ExceptionCount = count()
| project ExceptionCount
content.title: Total Exceptions

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(duration) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Average Response Time Over Time

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize RequestCount = count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Request Rate (requests per 5 minutes)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "WebhookProcessingTime"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend webhookType = tostring(customDimensions.webhookType)
| summarize Count = count() by webhookType
| render piechart
content.title: Webhooks Processed by Type

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "AlertNotificationSent"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend alertType = tostring(customDimensions.alertType)
| summarize Count = count() by alertType
| render piechart
content.title: Alert Notifications by Type

content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "AlertNotificationSent"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend 
    alertType = tostring(customDimensions.alertType),
    success = tostring(customDimensions.success)
| summarize 
    Total = count(),
    Successful = countif(success == "true")
    by alertType
| extend SuccessRate = round((Successful * 100.0) / Total, 2)
| project AlertType = alertType, Total, Successful, SuccessRate
| order by Total desc
content.title: Notification Success Rate by Alert Type

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "DeploymentApprovalTime"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend 
    environment = tostring(customDimensions.environment),
    outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize Count = count() by outcome
| render piechart
content.title: Deployment Approvals by Outcome

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize 
    Total = count(),
    Failed = countif(success == false)
    by target
| extend FailureRate = round((Failed * 100.0) / Total, 2)
| project Target = target, Total, Failed, FailureRate
| order by FailureRate desc
content.title: Dependency Success Rates

content.query:
dependencies
| where target == "api.github.com"
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize 
    AvgDuration = avg(duration),
    P95Duration = percentile(duration, 95),
    Count = count()
    by name
| project Operation = name, AvgDurationMs = round(AvgDuration, 2), P95DurationMs = round(P95Duration, 2), CallCount = Count
| order by AvgDurationMs desc
| take 10
content.title: Top 10 Slowest GitHub API Calls

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(duration) by target, bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Dependency Response Times Over Time

content.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by type, outerMessage
| order by Count desc
| take 10
content.title: Top 10 Exceptions

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange} and success == false
| summarize Count = count() by resultCode
| render piechart
content.title: Failed Requests by Status Code

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize 
    Total = count(),
    Failed = countif(success == false)
    by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| extend ErrorRate = (Failed * 100.0) / Total
| render timechart
content.title: Error Rate Trend

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where resultCode == 401
| summarize Count = count() by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Failed Authentication Attempts (401)

content.query:
dependencies
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where target == "api.github.com"
| where resultCode == 429
| summarize Count = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: GitHub API Rate Limit Hits (429)

content.query:
union customEvents, customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend repository = tostring(customDimensions.repository)
| where isnotempty(repository)
| summarize ActivityCount = count() by repository
| order by ActivityCount desc
| take 15
content.title: Top 15 Most Active Repositories
